summary: Still broken on main (1.9.0.5433, 13730886e) and on every stable release back to v1.4.1907, but in a different shape than reported: a static const array declared inside a member function is emitted with linkonce_odr rather than internal linkage, so dxilutil::IsStaticGlobal() skips it, LowerTypePass never flattens its <3 x float> element type, and dxc now rejects the shader with "External declaration ... is unused" / "Vector type <3 x float> is not allowed" (E_FAIL, no object emitted) instead of producing the bad bytecode the report describes. Pixel and mesh entry points both fail; all three reporter workarounds still compile; -spirv and clang accept the same source. Only -Vd produces a container, and it is unsigned with DXIL that dxv rejects.
text_stale: Body: "The following snippet compiles successfully with no errors" describes no stock configuration measured here -- main (1.9.0.5433) and v1.7.2207, the release nearest the reported build date, both reject it with a hard validation error and emit no object. Only -Vd, which disables validation and signing, produces a container.
title: Using a static const array in a member function declaration causes CREATEPIXELSHADER_INVALIDSHADERBYTECODE during CreatePipelineState
